release_notes: Campaign reports open again — the overlay had crashed to a white page since 1.7.1 (a hook read the date state before its declaration). Margin is now really computed: report rows, the report TOTAL and the campaigns-list TOTAL all rendered 0.00% before. Rotating the postback key rewrites the stored affiliate-network Postback URLs so the copy-for-your-manager link keeps working. The first-run wizard tells the real password minimum (8, not 6) and its server errors arrive in the interface language. EPC/CPC tooltips and the Exclude Safe Page hint follow the Keitaro-style click counting of 1.8.5. The ?tab=media and ?tab=push deep links land on their pages, and the dashboard Sources block counts unique visitors instead of a permanent 0. 17 beginner guides (EN/RU) join the docs with a 93-column metrics cheat sheet and a glossary. No schema changes; one new regression test.
